v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Proprio de Tempore

text.la: Líbera me * de sanguínibus, Deus, Deus meus: et exsultábit lingua mea iustítiam tuam.
text.en: Deliver me * from blood, O God, thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall extol thy justice.

text.la: Contumélias * et terróres passus sum ab eis: et Dóminus mecum est tamquam bellátor fortis.
text.en: I received * injuries and terrors from them: but the Lord is with me as a strong warrior.

text.la: Tu autem, Dómine, * scis omne consílium eórum advérsum me in mortem.
text.en: But thou, O Lord, * knowest all their plans to put me to death.

text.la: Omnes inimíci mei * audiérunt malum meum: Dómine, lætáti sunt, quóniam tu fecísti.
text.en: All my enemies have heard of my evil, * they have rejoiced that thou, O Lord, hast done it.

text.la: Fac, Dómine, * iudícium iniúriam patiéntibus: et vias peccatórum dispérde.
text.en: The Lord helpeth them * to right that suffer wrong, but as for the way of the ungodly, he turneth it upside down.

text.la: Veníte, mittámus lignum in panem eius, et eradámus eum de terra vivéntium, et nomen eius non memorétur ámplius.
text.en: Come, let us put wood on his bread, and cut him off from the land of the living, and let his name be remembered no more.

v.la: Éripe me de inimícis meis, Deus meus.
v.en: Deliver me from my enemies, O my God.

r.la: Et ab insurgéntibus in me líbera me.
r.en: And defend me from them that rise up against me.

text.la: Simon, dormis? * non potuísti una hora vigiláre mecum?
text.en: Simon, do you sleep? * Could you not watch one hour with me?

text.la: Præsta, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut, qui nostris excéssibus incessánter afflígimur, per unigéniti Fílii tui passiónem liberémur:
text.en: O Almighty God, we beseech Thee that we whose transgressions do unceasingly harm us, may find freedom in the Suffering of Thine Only-begotten Son. Who with thee liveth and reigneth, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
